name: context-handoff
description: Hands a long interactive session off to a fresh session at a turn end: the main model writes a full brief, the plugin checks it against its bundled template, clears after a cancellable grace, and seeds the new session from the brief. Includes /context-handoff:compact-crafter and mcp__context-handoff__handoff_now; Track is optional.

thresholdPercent.title: Handoff threshold (percent of the context window)
thresholdPercent.description: Optional, no default. When set (and CONTEXT_HANDOFF_THRESHOLD_TOKENS is not), the nudge and the automatic handoff use this context percentage instead of the token threshold. Integer 1-99. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_THRESHOLD_PERCENT.

thresholdTokens.title: Handoff threshold (context tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: At this many context tokens the mod nudges the model once to reach a checkpoint and stop; the automatic handoff then starts at a clean main-agent turn end. Applies unless a percent threshold is set. Integer 1-10000000. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_THRESHOLD_TOKENS (beats both).

ceilingTokens.title: Handoff ceiling (context tokens)
ceilingTokens.description: After the nudge, at this many context tokens the log says the handoff is past its ceiling; it still starts only at a clean turn end, never over background tasks, a draft or a pending typed prompt. Must be above the token threshold (otherwise threshold + 100000). Integer 1-10000000. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_CEILING_TOKENS.

nudgeTurnLimit.title: Turn ends to wait after the nudge
nudgeTurnLimit.description: After this many turn ends since the nudge without a clean one, the log says the handoff is past its turn limit; it still starts only at a clean turn end, never over background tasks, a draft or a pending typed prompt. Integer 1-20. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_NUDGE_TURN_LIMIT.

minGrowthTokens.title: Minimum growth of a handed-off session (tokens)
minGrowthTokens.description: A session created by a handoff must grow this many tokens past its first measured turn end before it can hand off again. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_MIN_GROWTH_TOKENS.

maxAutoChain.title: Handoffs in a row without a typed prompt
maxAutoChain.description: After this many handoffs with no prompt typed in between, no further handoff runs until you type one. 0 turns automatic handoff off. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_MAX_AUTO_CHAIN.

autoRunTimeoutSeconds.title: Automatic run timeout (seconds)
autoRunTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the automatic /context-handoff:compact-crafter run may take before it counts as a failed attempt and built-in compaction stays in charge. 30-1800. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_AUTO_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

autoRunToolCap.title: Automatic run tool calls
autoRunToolCap.description: Tool calls the automatic run may make before it counts as a failed attempt. 1-100. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_AUTO_RUN_TOOL_CAP.

clearGraceSeconds.title: Cancel window before the clear (seconds)
clearGraceSeconds.description: The countdown shown above the prompt, with a Cancel button, before the session is cleared. 1-120. Env override: CONTEXT_HANDOFF_CLEAR_GRACE_SECONDS.
